question: In which Olympics did PV Sindhu win a silver medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016 Summer Olympics (Rio)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• PV Sindhu won the **silver medal** in the women's singles badminton event at the **2016 Summer Olympics** held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
 
• She became the **first Indian woman** to win an Olympic silver medal in badminton and the youngest Indian to achieve this feat at the age of **21**.
 
• In the final match, PV Sindhu competed against Spain's Carolina Marin, the then World No. 1, and secured the second position.
 
• This historic achievement made her a household name in India and brought immense recognition to Indian badminton on the global stage.
 
• Her silver medal win was instrumental in inspiring a new generation of badminton players in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton at the Olympics:**

 
 
• Badminton was introduced in the Summer Olympics in **1992**, held in Barcelona, Spain.
 
• The five events in badminton at the Olympics are men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, women's doubles, and mixed doubles.
 
 
 
• **India’s Achievements in Badminton:**
 
 
• India has won several Olympic medals in badminton, including a bronze medal by Saina Nehwal in 2012 and a bronze by PV Sindhu in 2020 (Tokyo).
 
• PV Sindhu remains the only Indian to have won two Olympic medals in badminton (a silver in 2016 and a bronze in 2020).
 
 
 
• **PV Sindhu’s Career Highlights:**
 
 
• PV Sindhu is a World Champion, having won the gold medal at the **2019 BWF World Championships**.
 
• She has won multiple titles, including medals at the Commonwealth Games, Asian Games, and BWF tournaments.
 
 
 
• **2016 Summer Olympics (Rio):**
 
 
• The 2016 Olympics were held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, from **August 5 to August 21, 2016**.
 
• India won two medals at this edition: PV Sindhu's silver in badminton and Sakshi Malik's bronze in wrestling.
